Currently allowed browser origins (CORS in `worker/src/index.ts`): `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where it's configured:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `app.use('*', cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} }))` middleware (near the top, right after `app.use('*', logger())`). It's a function (not an array) because Hono's array matching is exact-string only, so wildcards must be handled in code.

**To add a new custom domain:** add an `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` (or `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')`) check inside that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts`. Also update the docs for consistency: `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 and `worker/src/index.md`.
